environment.tool: manual audit of the final tag source + live compiled binary; raw-socket client sending exact bytes, strict-token upstream peer logging verbatim request bytes and byte count

findings.description: This build has no fixed hop list: every forwarded header is filtered by hasToken against the client's own Connection value, and no Content-Length is ever re-added. A POST whose body carries the upstream exec line therefore leaves the proxy with no framing, and the upstream answers the POST, then reads the body as a fresh request and executes it. One client request, one execution, no encoding.
findings.title: Connection: content-length forwards the POST body unframed, so the upstream parses the body as a second request and executes it

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
